{{Quote|These are ''dangerous'' times. We've picked up intel on a ''Rebel cell'' operating near here. Now&hellip;you wouldn't happen to ''know'' anything about that&hellip;''would'' you, Rallo?|Captain Turrant|<ref name="Lucky (comic)">{{Tales|23|Lucky (comic story)}}</ref>}}
A [[Corellian Resistance/Legends|Rebel]] '''cell''' operated on [[Gus Talon/Legends|Gus Talon]], one of the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was led by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rallo]] until the cell was discovered by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Turrant]], who responded by calling in a devastating [[Bombing of Gus Talon|bombardment of Gus Talon]]. The attack [[Death/Legends|killed]] both Rallo and his daughter, [[Mala Tinero]], prompting future Rebel [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] hero [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] to join the Alliance.
